name: World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top prize, changing hands twice across its two surviving broadcasts — once in the ring, once by presidential presentation.

name: North American Championship
epitaph: The promotion's secondary singles title, won in the ring on its own 4 October 1997 broadcast and, by December, held by a different man; how it changed hands is not recorded.

name: Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's lighter-weight singles title, changing hands in an instant reversal on its own 4 October 1997 broadcast.

name: World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own tag team title, called the Hardcore Tag Team Championship in its own earlier recruitment posts and held by Storm Inc. by December 1997.
